items.notes: Missing the core claim that a write whose reply was lost is an unknown outcome rather than a failed write, so a stale read is not proof that the commit never happened.

Missing the core claim that the BFF is tightly coupled to and released with one client while the composed services have independent lifecycles, so the composition contract must be versioned and the client contract tested.
Missing the core claim that adding an index is a data-lifecycle change whose end-to-end cost in write latency, WAL volume, storage, vacuum and planning must be compared with the scan it removes.
Missing the core claim that a 95% interval covers the true mean only under the model's assumptions and does not cover the production value or a single future request.
Missing the core claim that the main sensitivity scenario converges at 0.00016 relative error under a quadratic screening approximation rather than a full Sobol analysis.
